name: OrderFirst — Distributed Microservices & Zero-Downtime CI/CD Platform
summary: A distributed restaurant ordering and table reservation platform engineered with an event-driven microservices architecture, schema isolation, and automated zero-downtime deployment.
problem: Monolithic deployment coupled all services into slow all-or-nothing rebuilds, shared database schema bottlenecks, and downtime risks during releases.
solution: Decoupled into 6 independent microservices orchestrated by a Jenkins monorepo pipeline featuring selective git-diff change detection, parallel quality gates, and zero-downtime rolling updates.
devopsHighlights: Monorepo change detection: evaluates git diff to run parallel typecheck, unit tests, and Docker builds only for modified services
Zero-downtime rolling deployment using Docker Compose without restarting database, message broker, or untouched containers
Multi-platform container packaging (linux/amd64 & linux/arm64) and hardened dual-network isolation (zero exposed DB ports in prod)
applicationFeatures: High-concurrency table reservations protected by PostgreSQL btree_gist anti-overlap exclusion constraints
Fault-tolerant order processing with circuit-breaker resiliency and catalog inventory sync
Asynchronous transactional event processing and OTP dispatch via RabbitMQ messaging daemon
outcome: Eliminated monorepo release bottlenecks, reduced CI pipeline execution overhead, and enabled reliable, zero-downtime rolling production deployments.

name: DevTalk — Developer Community & CI/CD Platform
summary: A LinkedIn-inspired community where developers solve coding problems, publish blogs, and connect through jobs.
problem: Manual testing, scanning, image builds, and server commands made every release slow and inconsistent.
solution: A GitHub-triggered Jenkins pipeline tests, analyzes, scans, builds, and deploys the Docker Compose stack.
devopsHighlights: Push-to-deploy workflow using GitHub webhooks and Jenkins
Reusable stages for tests, SonarQube analysis, and Trivy scanning
Managed secrets and repeatable multi-container deployments
applicationFeatures: Accounts, posts, comments, and developer blogs
Real-time notifications for likes, comments, and applications
outcome: Turned manual releases into one repeatable, quality-gated path from commit to deployment.

name: Carbon Credit Platform — Enterprise Sustainability & Automated Delivery
summary: An enterprise carbon credit lifecycle management platform handling end-to-end methodology definition, project validation, and verifiable inventory tracking.
problem: Complex regulatory auditing and manual verification processes led to sluggish release cycles and risky data inconsistencies.
solution: Engineered a performant Next.js SSR/SSG architecture with schema-enforced relational modeling in PostgreSQL and automated GitHub Actions verification workflows.
devopsHighlights: Automated CI/CD workflows triggered on pull requests ensuring clean build artifacts and test passes
Immutable container builds with multi-stage Dockerfiles optimizing runtime footprint
High reliability relational schema design using PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM with automated migrations
applicationFeatures: Methodology creation, project setup, and inventory tracking for enterprise clients
Modular state management using Jotai and resilient server-side data fetching
Fine-grained role-based permissions and cryptographic audit trail generation
outcome: Delivered dependable enterprise-grade releases with automated regression gates and seamless production deployments.

name: KinD Kubernetes Platform — Multi-Tier Topology & Ingress Automation
summary: A full-scale local Kubernetes cluster topology deploying high-availability services with Ingress-NGINX routing, local registry caching, and dual-tier stateful databases.
problem: Developing and debugging complex distributed Kubernetes workloads locally often leads to parity mismatches with remote staging environments.
solution: Automated a complete local KinD cluster orchestration including node-port mappings, an integrated local container registry, and unified declarative Ingress routing.
devopsHighlights: Custom KinD cluster manifest with multi-worker nodes and extraPortMappings for ports 80/443
Automatic local container registry hosting at localhost:5001 connected to the cluster bridge
Persistent volumes for MongoDB and Redis with decoupled ConfigMaps and Secrets
applicationFeatures: Ingress-NGINX controller with path-based routing across microservice endpoints
Declarative Kubernetes Deployments, ClusterIP Services, and PersistentVolumeClaims
Automated health checks with readiness and liveness probes
outcome: Achieved 100% development-to-production parity for multi-container Kubernetes topologies with rapid local iteration.

name: Minipay Wallet — Web3 Mobile Platform & Smart Contract Automation
summary: High-throughput mobile wallet infrastructure serving over 200,000 active users, featuring smart contract execution, RainbowKit authentication, and automated bundle optimization.
problem: Handling high-frequency decentralized transactions required rock-solid transaction validation, strict client error budgets, and zero regression leaks.
solution: Built contract interaction modules via Ethers.js, layered secure wallet state management, and integrated comprehensive linting and testing in CI pipelines.
devopsHighlights: CI/CD verification of blockchain RPC connectivity and smart contract ABI definitions
Automated bundle analysis preventing bloat on mobile client bundles
Isolated environment secret injection preventing sensitive key exposures
applicationFeatures: Seamless wallet connection through RainbowKit with multi-network support
Gas estimation and fault-tolerant transaction queuing with user feedback
High performance responsive mobile interface optimized for low-bandwidth devices
outcome: Maintained uninterrupted service across 200K+ mobile users with automated pre-merge validation pipelines.

name: Hardened Jenkins CI/CD Controller — DevSecOps Pipeline
summary: A security-first, containerized Jenkins controller deployed on Ubuntu Linux with integrated SonarQube static code quality analysis and Trivy container vulnerability scanning.
problem: Standard CI pipelines often ship vulnerabilities undetected and lack reproducible, version-controlled controller environments.
solution: Packaged a containerized Jenkins controller with automated plugins, Docker daemon mounting, and strict pipeline quality gates that fail builds on severe vulnerabilities.
devopsHighlights: Zero-privilege Docker group socket integration for non-root Jenkins runner execution
Automated Trivy vulnerability scanner step blocking builds on CRITICAL or HIGH severity CVEs
SonarQube webhook feedback gating staging and production branch merges
applicationFeatures: Declarative Jenkinsfile pipeline with parameterized build matrices
Automated systemd service management for continuous controller availability
Secure credential store integration with multi-tenant secret separation
outcome: Transformed manual deployments into an automated, security-gated delivery platform with verified zero-CVE builds.
